lessons.title: Planting trees
lessons.kind: 对话 · 刘老师与同学们讨论植树活动
en: Good morning, everyone!
Who is on weather duty today?
It’s me!
Today is Monday, March 1.
The temperature will reach 15°C by noon and drop to 2°C at night.
Overall, it will be a warm, cloudy day.
Well done, Wang Mei.
The days are getting longer, and spring is coming.
We have a school project on March 12.
Can you guess what it is?
Is it tree planting?
Good guess.
Do you know how to plant trees?
Yes.
I learned to plant trees when I visited my uncle last spring.
It was so much fun.
Could you tell us the steps for planting trees?
Sure.
First, dig a large hole.
Then, place the seedling inside the hole, and cover its roots with soil.
Finally, press down the soil.
Oh, don’t forget to water the tree.
Excellent, Li Ming.
Why do people plant trees?
Do you have any ideas?
Trees help protect the soil from rainfall.
Trees prevent dust from spreading.
Good points.
Planting trees is also a wonderful way to learn more about nature.
I believe you will have a great time with this project.
zh: 大家早上好！
今天谁值日报告天气？
是我！
今天是星期一，三月一号。
中午气温会升到15摄氏度，夜里降到2摄氏度。
总的来说，今天是温暖多云的一天。
说得真好，王梅。
白天越来越长，春天就要来了。
三月十二日我们有一个学校活动。
你们能猜到是什么吗？
是去植树吗？
猜得真准。
你们知道怎么种树吗？
知道。
去年春天我去舅舅家，学会了种树。
那可真好玩。
你能告诉我们植树的步骤吗？
当然可以。
先挖一个大坑。
然后把树苗放进坑里，用土盖住树根。
最后把土压实。
哦，别忘了给树浇水。
讲得太好了，李明。
人们为什么要种树呢？
你们有什么想法吗？
树木能保护土壤不被雨水冲走。
树木能挡住灰尘，不让它到处飞扬。
说得都有道理。
植树也是了解大自然的好办法。
我相信你们一定会在这个活动里玩得很开心。

lessons.title: It's getting warmer!
lessons.kind: 书信 · 王梅写给詹妮的电子邮件
en: Dear Jenny, Today is March 6.
Jingzhe falls on this day this year.
Do you know what Jingzhe is?
It is one of China’s 24 solar terms, and it means “awakening of insects”.
The spring thunder wakes insects up from their sleep.
Then nature begins to come back to life.
Spring is in the air.
This morning, the temperature was 10°C in my city.
It reached 15°C this afternoon.
It was quite warm.
I don’t need my heavy winter coat or boots now!
On my way to school, I saw some winter jasmine blossoming.
People believe the blossom of this flower always tells the coming of spring, so we call winter jasmine “the welcoming-spring flower”.
I like spring.
It is the best season for going out.
We are going to be more active, like insects!
We will form a music band.
There is going to be a basketball game next week.
My class is also planning a field trip.
We will plant trees.
I can’t wait!
What’s the weather like in Canada?
What type of classic spring activities do you do?
Wang Mei
zh: 亲爱的詹妮，今天是三月六日。
今年惊蛰正好就在今天。
你知道惊蛰是什么吗？
它是中国二十四节气之一，意思是万物复苏、虫儿苏醒。
春雷把昆虫从冬眠中唤醒。
接着大自然就开始复苏了。
春天已经到来。
今天早上，我市气温是10摄氏度。
下午升到了15摄氏度。
挺暖和的。
我现在不用穿厚重的冬衣和靴子啦！
上学路上，我看见迎春花开了。
人们觉得这种花开就意味着春天来了，所以叫它迎春花。
我喜欢春天。
它是最适合出去玩的季节。
我们也要像虫子一样活跃起来啦！
我们要组建一个乐队。
下周还有一场篮球赛。
我们班也在计划一次户外郊游。
我们要去种树。
我等不及啦！
加拿大的天气怎么样？
你们春天会做哪些经典的活动？
王梅

lessons.title: The Spring City
lessons.kind: 叙述 · 第一人称介绍家乡昆明（春城）
en: When we talk about spring, we think of a season of warm weather and fresh air.
We also think of new life, green plants, and budding trees all around us.
Spring is short in many places around the world.
But in my hometown, it feels like spring nearly all year round.
The weather here is neither too hot nor too cold.
The average temperature in winter is 15°C.
In summer, the average temperature is 24°C.
While the sun is shining, the temperature remains pleasant.
The city gets about 2,250 hours of sunshine and about 1,000 millimetres of rain every year.
Because the weather is spring-like, you can find hundreds of beautiful flowers and trees all year round.
There are many famous scenic spots in my hometown.
The Stone Forest is a must-see for tourists from home and abroad.
There are many special rocks that look like tall stone trees.
The Dianchi Lake is the biggest in Yunnan Province.
You can enjoy the beauty of the area and go boating or take a walk by the water.
Can you guess the name of my hometown?
Yes, it’s Kunming — the Spring City.
Welcome to my hometown.
When you visit, you will feel our warmth and friendliness, just like spring!
zh: 说起春天，我们想到的是温暖的天气和清新的空气。
还有新的生命、绿色的植物，以及周围发芽的树木。
春天在世界许多地方都很短暂。
但在我的家乡，几乎一年到头都像春天。
这里的天气既不太热也不太冷。
冬天平均气温是15摄氏度。
夏天平均气温是24摄氏度。
阳光照耀时，气温一直很宜人。
这座城市每年约有2250小时日照，约1000毫米降水。
因为气候像春天，一年四季都能看到成百上千的美丽花草树木。
我的家乡有许多著名的景点。
石林是国内外游客必看的地方。
那里有许多奇特的岩石，像高高的石树。
滇池是云南省最大的湖泊。
你可以欣赏美景，也可以划船或在湖边散步。
你能猜出我家乡的名字吗？
没错，就是昆明——春城。
欢迎来到我的家乡。
你来了一定会感受到我们像春天一样的热情和友好！

lessons.title: Stories about spring
lessons.kind: 说明+书信 · 土拨鼠日文化小贴士与詹妮的回信
en: Groundhog Day is on February 2.
On that day, a small animal called groundhog comes out of its hole in the ground.
Dear Wang Mei, It isn’t snowing today, but there is still snow on the grass.
In Edmonton, the spring weather is a little wild.
It can be cold and snowy or warm and sunny.
The temperature can be as low as -15°C, but it can also reach 15°C.
We probably won’t see any flowers until May or June!
After school today, we had so much fun playing outside.
We played “snow” soccer, but we had to wear jackets, jeans, and boots to stay warm.
When it gets warmer, we can play in our shorts and T-shirts.
I like spring because there are lots of activities to do, like cycling, having picnics, and hiking.
I like the Chinese name for winter jasmine.
It’s interesting.
Here, we have Groundhog Day on February 2 for the coming of spring.
Do you know what happens on that day?
Another fun part of spring is going to the sugar bush, a big tree farm in the countryside.
We make maple syrup.
We eat lots of tasty breakfast foods — all with maple syrup on them!
I love spring activities.
Talk to you soon!
Jenny
zh: 土拨鼠日在二月二日。
那一天，一种叫土拨鼠的小动物会从地下的洞里钻出来。
亲爱的王梅，今天没下雪，但草地上还有积雪。
在埃德蒙顿，春天的天气有点变化无常。
可能又冷又雪，也可能温暖晴朗。
气温最低能到零下15摄氏度，也可能升到15摄氏度。
我们可能要到五月或六月才能看到花呢！
今天放学后，我们在外面玩得可开心了。
我们踢了雪地足球，得穿上夹克、牛仔裤和靴子保暖。
等天气暖和了，我们就能穿短裤T恤去玩了。
我喜欢春天，因为有好多活动可以玩，像骑车、野餐和徒步。
我喜欢迎春花的中文名字。
挺有意思的。
我们这儿二月二有土拨鼠日，迎接春天到来。
你知道那天会发生什么吗？
春天另一件好玩的事，是去乡下的糖树林，那是一个大农场。
我们制作枫糖浆。
我们吃很多好吃的早餐，全都浇上枫糖浆！
我爱春天的各种活动。
回头再聊！
詹妮

lessons.title: Jeremy's observation diary
lessons.kind: 日记 · 杰里米的豌豆生长观察日记
en: In the life skills class last week, we learned about agriculture and plant biology.
The teacher gave us some seeds so we could observe the growing process of a plant.
I picked some pea seeds and planted them in a small pot.
I watered them every day.
I hope my peas grow quickly!
Here are some of my observations on the peas’ growth:
Date: March 3 Weather conditions: sunny, temperature around 18°C
Observations: The pea seeds grew into buds.
They look like the English letter “Y”.
My peas are growing quickly!
Date: April 3 Weather conditions: rainy, temperature around 22°C
Observations: The pea flowers are in full bloom.
Some are pink and some are purple.
When the pea plants grow taller, I will give them a shelf to climb on.
Date: March 30 Weather conditions: cloudy, temperature around 19°C
Observations: Now, there are long, thin stems and some leaves.
At the top of the stems are little flower buds!
I put the pot in the yard.
There, they can get some sunshine.
zh: 上周生活技能课，我们学习了农业和植物学。
老师发给我们一些种子，让我们观察植物的生长过程。
我挑了些豌豆种子，种在小花盆里。
我每天给它们浇水。
希望我的豌豆快快长大！
以下是我对豌豆生长的一些观察：
日期：三月三日 天气：晴，气温约18摄氏度
观察：豌豆种子发芽了。
它们长得像英文字母 Y。
我的豌豆长得真快！
日期：四月三日 天气：雨，气温约22摄氏度
观察：豌豆花全开了。
有的粉，有的紫。
等豌豆长高了，我给它们搭个架子爬。
日期：三月三十日 天气：多云，气温约19摄氏度
观察：现在有了细长的茎和一些叶子。
茎的顶上还冒出了小花苞！
我把花盆放到了院子里。
那儿能让它们晒到太阳。

lessons.title: The 24 solar terms
lessons.kind: 说明文 · 春季六个节气介绍
en: The 24 solar terms reflect the wisdom of our ancestors.
They help us understand how nature changes throughout the year.
Our ancestors observed nature and created the Chinese lunar calendar to guide farming and daily life.
There are several solar terms for the spring season.
They tell us about the coming of this beautiful season.
Start of Spring
It usually falls around February 4 or 5 and marks the beginning of spring.
The weather starts to get warmer and we can see new plants grow and animals become active after a long winter.
Rain Water
It arrives around February 19 or 20.
It reminds us of the increase in rainfall as the weather gets warmer.
Jingzhe (Awakening of Insects)
It usually takes place around March 5 or 6.
Jingzhe tells us that insects are coming out of hibernation.
We might hear more birds singing and see butterflies and bees buzzing around.
Spring Equinox
It comes around March 20 or 21, when the length of the day is nearly equal to that of the night.
Qingming (Clear and Bright)
It usually falls around April 4 or 5.
Qingming is a time when people honour their ancestors.
It’s also a time to enjoy outdoor activities and the beauty of spring.
Grain Rain
It occurs around April 19 or 20.
Farmers sow seeds during this time, and the rain nourishes the soil to make sure the farmers have a good harvest in the future.
These solar terms teach us how to follow the seasons and make the best of them.
They show us the relationship between humans and nature and call upon us to respect the world around us.
zh: 二十四节气体现了祖先的智慧。
它们帮我们了解大自然一年里的变化。
祖先观察自然，创制了农历，指导农耕和日常生活。
春季有好几个节气。
它们告诉我们这个美好季节的到来。
立春
它通常在二月四五日，标志着春天开始。
天气开始转暖，我们能看到植物发芽、动物在漫长冬天后活跃起来。
雨水
它在二月十九或二十日前后到来。
它提醒我们，天气转暖，雨水增多。
惊蛰（虫儿苏醒）
它通常在三月五六日。
惊蛰告诉我们，昆虫正从冬眠中苏醒。
我们可能会听到更多鸟鸣，看到蝴蝶蜜蜂飞来飞去。
春分
它在三月二十或二十一日，这天昼长几乎和夜长相等。
清明（气清景明）
它通常在四月四五日。
清明是人们祭奠祖先的时节。
也是外出游玩、欣赏春景的好时候。
谷雨
它在四月十九或二十日前后。
农民这时播种，雨水滋润土地，好让将来有个好收成。
这些节气教我们如何顺应时令，充分利用它们。
它们展示了人与自然的关系，也呼吁我们尊重周围的世界。
